newsitem.title: USA: U.S. seeks more info on James River/Ft Howard deal.
newsitem.headline: U.S. seeks more info on James River/Ft Howard deal.

text.p: The U.S. Justice Department has requested additional information on the proposed merger of James River Corp and Fort Howard Corp, extending the waiting period for the deal under antitrust law, James River said Monday.

The Justice Department request extends the waiting period until 20 days after the companies comply. James River and Fort Howard have begun collecting the requested information and intend to reply promptly, James River said.
"This action by the Department of Justice is not uncommon in mergers of this type," said Miles Marsh, chairman and chief executive officer of James River.
The companies believe the merger is pro-competitive, James River said.
The companies announced a definitive merger agreement May 5.
